Under actual GD,N=2,psi=1 and the three auxiliary units, actual TypeII and every essentially self-dual stable TypeI source are excluded. Scalar normalization removes the determinant assumption from every projectively odd GQ adjoint origin; quadratic descent supplies such an origin for every self-dual source. Actual host counterfamilies, exact Selmer/conormal equivalence and missing global extension control remain documented. Known low-degree class-number inputs remove all rational character orders1–4; remaining order≥5. Exact ordinary inertia further excludes monomial sources and finite projective image; this does not supply the missing arithmetic extension bound. The Jacobi heat/Sturm theorem now constructs odd GD fields |D|<4p with class-number unit plus the specified twisted unit under B_(2b)/(2b) unit, b in[3,p−2],b≠(p−1)/2. It has unconditional nonquadratic mirror family e=(p+1)/2 for p3mod4, and a separate automatic TypeII-excluding field family e=(p+1)/4 for p7mod8. The two twisted units are not proved simultaneous over one D. A selected valid heat-coefficient field can fail the third unit (p31,D−79); simultaneous existence remains open. Cubic cohomology retains a rational strict class-group obstruction and explicit local terms; no actual Massey nonvanishing is proved. Fixed-weight real/imaginary special-value reformulation does not establish simultaneous units. The ordinary cubic jet has an exact relative obstruction; actual-source extraction needs additional valuation and sparse-support hypotheses, and a flat-domain example prevents inferring it just from a characteristic-zero point.

Excision now identifies its full class component, including the local correction, and an explicit absolute lift matches the specified system to a norm representative. The matched-y norm identity is exact; the prior proper-terminology-only proof gap is recorded and repaired. Arithmetic evaluation and actual-source comparison remain open. An exact Eisenstein modular-symbol coefficient detects both same-D Bernoulli units, but no nonzero quadratic evaluation or class-number condition is supplied by the high-order-character nonvanishing theorem. The norm comparison now extends to every finite coefficient field by quadratic polarization. Positive quartic and lower quintic relative obstructions are explicit; the latter has dimension 1+d for the original strict rational class dimension d. A senary genus trace is an exact same-D two-unit detector, but individual coefficient units can cancel in the trace. None evaluates a required obstruction or proves simultaneous unit existence.
